描述_EN: the sketchy strokes depict a man on horseback accompanied by his assistants, travelling on a precipitous mountain path. the artist's signature and seal can be seen (and almost hidden) on the far right. unlike the works in his typical style, this painting by zhou chen (c.1450 - 1535) employs bolder and looser brushwork, suggesting that it was made by this suzhou artist in his late years. originally painted on the gold-sprinkled paper of a folding-fan (a new format for painting at the time), the work later was mounted as an album leaf. the twin seals on the lower left corner indicate that the painting was once collected by a certain 'shiduan,' a liberary name of a person.
描述_ZN: 简笔画描绘了一个骑马的人在他的助手的陪同下，在一条险峻的山路上旅行。 艺术家的签名和印章可以在最右边看到（而且几乎是隐藏的）。 与他典型风格的作品不同，周臣（约1450-1535）的这幅画采用了更大胆、更松散的笔触，表明它是这位苏州艺术家晚年的作品。 最初画在折扇的洒金纸上（当时一种新的绘画形式），后来作品被装裱成册页。 左下角的双印表明，这幅画曾被某位 "师团"（一种自由的人名）收藏。
